clips.text: It is impossible to conceive of the divine intellectually, and that is why the intellect denies it or creates fictitious systems about it, which is even more dangerous than plain denial.
The mind works only in the circle of the known; it cannot transcend the world of the known.
For the mind the unknown is not.
Says Attar: You know nothing of your real self here and in this state.
You are like the wax in the honeycomb - what does it know of fire or guttering?
But when it gets to the stage of the waxen candle and when light is emitted then it knows.
